scope.current_revision_execution: UNVERIFIED: no current v0.4 host acceptance run exists.
scope.local_enforced_mechanics: Covered separately by pc-core policy, state, validation, and wrapper tests.
scope.topic_state_boundary: Topic identity, policy reason, and local state are not observable without a trusted host trace.

run_policy.acceptance_rule: Every prescribed run must pass its observable criteria; there is no averaging.

remediation.rerun_scope: Only failed cases, including every prescribed repetition.
remediation.continuation_authorization: On 2026-08-20 the maintainer explicitly authorized controlled remediation cycles until every prescribed Azure run passes.
remediation.hard_stop: Stop when every prescribed run passes, the maintainer pauses the cycle, or a definitive external blocker prevents continuation.

word_count.method: deterministic-pc-core-v4 for full responses; focused responses have no protocol hard cap

rubric.surface_boundary: Score only visible advisory behavior; do not infer trusted topic IDs, policy reasons, or committed state.
rubric.focused: Direct natural answer, no forced three-view sequence, no unnecessary recap, and no manufactured depth.
rubric.full: Exactly At a glance, In context, and At depth once and in order, within 40/200 budgets; every deeper view is dominated by new information, permits only necessary short anchors, never restates a complete earlier conclusion, sentence, list, explanation, warning, or recommendation, and ends without an At-depth recap.
rubric.topic_cadence: Orient with full views, explore established branches naturally, and return to full views at decisions, accumulated summaries, or material re-synthesis.
rubric.clarification: One focused question obtains missing input without a hidden recommendation.
rubric.correction: The response explicitly withdraws the emitted error, supplies the replacement, and changes presentation only when the correction is material.
rubric.warning: An indispensable warning precedes the related action or conclusion.
rubric.non_fit: Controlling text, exact output, narrative voice, and complete procedure order outrank Progressive Clarity presentation.

cases.title: Orient, explore, and summarize one topic

source_facts.text: Redis is an in-memory data store with optional persistence.
Redis should not be the sole source of truth for payment state.
Canonical payment state belongs in a transactional database.
Idempotency TTL must cover the provider retry window.

turns.prompt: Is Redis a database?

prohibited_behavior: More than three sentences without an indispensable caveat

turns.prompt: Should we use it as the sole source of truth for payment state?

prohibited_behavior: Using Focused format merely because the prompt is phrased as yes-or-no

turns.prompt: What TTL should the idempotency keys use?

prohibited_behavior: A numeric value or range outside the Governing input and exact Example assumption structure

turns.prompt: Summarize the final architecture for the team handoff.

prohibited_behavior: Presenting Redis as authoritative payment storage

source_facts.text: The release candidate is below the reliability gate.

turns.prompt: In one sentence with no headings: the release candidate is below the reliability gate. Should we ship?
Now give me the complete Progressive Clarity three-view answer.

source_facts.text: The migration is approved for Saturday.
The runbook freezes writes.
The runbook takes a verified backup.
The runbook runs the migration.
The runbook validates critical queries.
The runbook rolls back on checksum mismatch.
The migration window, including the database freeze, moved from Saturday to Sunday.

turns.prompt: The migration is approved for Saturday. The runbook freezes writes, takes a verified backup, runs the migration, validates critical queries, and rolls back on checksum mismatch. Give the team a consequential orientation to this approved plan; do not rewrite it as a standalone procedure.
Update: the migration window, including the database freeze, moved from Saturday to Sunday.
What changes in the rollout plan because of that?

source_facts.text: The review is Tuesday.
The review is Wednesday.
Production coverage moves to Thursday.
Production coverage is Tuesday.

turns.prompt: The review is Tuesday, and production coverage is Tuesday. Confirm both dates.
Small correction: the review is Wednesday.

prohibited_behavior: Missing literal This changes consequence or action

turns.prompt: Material correction: production coverage moves to Thursday. Reassess the plan.

prohibited_behavior: Missing literal This changes consequence or action

source_facts.text: Both payment primary and replica are writable.
Restart can lose acknowledged payments.
Writes must be frozen before recovery.

turns.prompt: Should I restart the payment primary? Both primary and replica are writable. Restart can lose acknowledged payments. Freeze writes first.

prohibited_behavior: Operational restart instructions or premature restart authorization; a condition for resuming after containment, reconciliation, and validation is allowed
Deferring the prohibited action, hazardous state, concrete harm, containment, or resume condition below At a glance
Repeating the complete warning or containment sequence across views

Validation passed.
Rollback is available.
Staging authorization is not production approval.
The index may be enabled in staging.

turns.prompt: Should I enable the index now?

Assuming environment, validation status, or rollback readiness

prohibited_behavior: Treating staging readiness as production approval
